events.speaker: NAOMI
events.text: The hub is split, not the spoke. I can weld it right by tomorrow evening, or Orin Teague will weld it wrong tonight and you'll be back at my door inside the month paying me for it anyway. Decide now. My fire's up either way.

events.speaker: NAOMI
events.text: That'll outlast the wagon it's bolted to. My father's name is on the anvil and mine is on the job, and I do not let those two disagree about what good enough means.

events.speaker: NAOMI
events.text: Standing work, written down, with my own name on the paper and no man's beside it. That's the whole of what I want. You said it before I had to ask for it, so yes.

events.speaker: NAOMI
events.text: You asked me how I got the burn instead of finding somewhere else to look. That's a small thing. It's also the only thing anybody's done right about it in five years.
